text: Status at fleet stand-down (worker-2): implementation was already committed on beads-worker-2 in 9e8cae59b5 (+220: durable_count gate recounted at open, cache-skip load, LRU evict, tests) and 3aa7b4245c (fmt + announce.rs test formatting). TEST EXECUTION IS BLOCKED on heft by qhh6 (E0599 in secure.rs - pre-existing, unrelated to this bead's files): cargo test -p lichen-node cannot run here, so per the never-close-without-green-tests rule this bead stays in_progress. Remaining to close: fix qhh6 (commit+push Mac crates/oscore observe work to the fork, git pull on heft), run cargo test -p lichen-node + fmt + clippy, then close t8ox and p4mf. Cargo.toml patch-path swap and scripts/ round files left uncommitted intentionally (fleet convention, launcher-owned).
